metadata.question: On July 7, did the coastal city of La Serena have a year-to-date rainfall deficit of larger than 40 percent (compared to the mean from 1990-2020)?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: La Serena is a coastal city in Chile (approximately -29.9°, -71.25°) - Need rainfall data for: * Year-to-date 2024 (Jan 1 - July 7) * Historical mean for same period (Jan 1 - July 7) from 1990-2020 - Best dataset: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) - daily precipitation at 0.05° resolution 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for CHIRPS (it's a precipitation product, not optical imagery) - Just sum precipitation values 3. Logic: - Calculate total rainfall Jan 1 - July 7, 2024 - Calculate mean total rainfall Jan 1 - July 7 for 1990-2020 (31 years) - Calculate deficit percentage: ((historical_mean - current) / historical_mean) * 100 - If deficit > 40%, answer A (Yes) - If deficit <= 40%, answer B (No) - Check for C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for La Serena, Chile const laSerena = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.25, -29.9]); const buffer = laSerena.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around city center // 2. Get 2024 year-to-date rainfall (Jan 1 - July 7, 2024) const current = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate('2024-01-01', '2024-07-08') .filterBounds(buffer); const currentSize = current.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Current year images (2024): ${currentSize}`); if (currentSize === 0) { console.log("No data available for 2024."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate current year total rainfall const currentSum = current.sum(); const currentRainfall = currentSum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const currentVal = currentRainfall.getInfo(); if (currentVal === null || currentVal === undefined) { console.log("Failed to calculate current rainfall."); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`2024 YTD rainfall (Jan 1 - Jul 7): ${currentVal.toFixed(2)} mm`); // 4. Calculate historical mean (1990-2020, same period) let historicalSum = 0; let yearCount = 0; for (let year = 1990; year <= 2020; year++) { const historical = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(`${year}-01-01`, `${year}-07-08`) .filterBounds(buffer); const histSize = historical.size().getInfo(); if (histSize > 0) { const histSum = historical.sum(); const histRainfall = histSum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const histVal = histRainfall.getInfo(); if (histVal !== null && histVal !== undefined) { historicalSum += histVal; yearCount++; } } } if (yearCount === 0) { console.log("No historical data available."); console.log("C1"); return; } const historicalMean = historicalSum / yearCount; console.log(`Historical mean (1990-2020): ${historicalMean.toFixed(2)} mm (${yearCount} years)`); // 5. Calculate deficit percentage const deficit = ((historicalMean - currentVal) / historicalMean) * 100; console.log(`Deficit: ${deficit.toFixed(1)}%`); // 6. Determine answer if (deficit > 40) { console.log(`Deficit of ${deficit.toFixed(1)}% is greater than 40%.`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Deficit of ${deficit.toFixed(1)}% is not greater than 40%.`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
